meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 它会一步步带你建好第一个 NanoClaw agent:确认你在频道里的身份、把私聊消息组接到新 agent 上,并经由正常投递路径发一条欢迎私信来验证端到端投递。重复运行是安全的。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置、服务正在运行之后使用;当你要为某个频道创建第一个 agent、并把它的私聊接起来时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Discord 上初始化第一个 agent
say.note: 会先问频道、你的用户 id 和显示名

say.text: 用我的 Telegram 账号建一个私聊 agent,名字叫小助手
say.note: 脚本会建组、接线并发出欢迎私信

say.text: 欢迎私信一直没到,帮我查一下
say.note: 会查 outbound 记录和日志定位问题

howto.what_en: It walks you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a channel: resolve your channel identity, wire the DM group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM through the normal delivery path. Reruns are safe.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running; when you want to create the first agent for a channel and wire up its DM.

say_en.text: Set up my first agent on Discord
say_en.note: It first asks for the channel, your user id and display name

say_en.text: Create a DM agent on Telegram named Helper
say_en.note: The script creates the group, wires it and sends the welcome DM

say_en.text: The welcome DM never arrived, help me diagnose
say_en.note: It checks outbound records and logs
